In this module you write your first systematic review and meta-analysis, together with one or two fellow students. All groups work on the same question: **does exposure to thimerosal-containing vaccines increase the risk of autism spectrum disorder in children?**

## How a week works

1. **Learn the concepts.** Use the concept list of the week page, the textbook, an AI tutor in learning mode, or come to the lecture. The slides are online before the lecture.
2. **Practise.** Every week page has practice questions with answers.
3. **Quiz.** At the start of the next tutorial you take a short paper quiz on those concepts.
4. **Work on your review.** The rest of the tutorial is for the weekly assignment, with the tutor available for questions.
5. **Hand in** before the deadline via the [submission form](../submit.qmd).
